## About Me

I am an **Analytics & CRM Specialist at Shohoz**, Bangladesh’s premier ride-hailing, ticketing, and logistics super-app, where I leverage customer data and custom tooling to optimize campaign performance and drive retention. Passionate about automation, I also build independent engineering projects to assist my day-to-day analysis tasks—such as data scrapers, dashboards, and micro-SaaS products—focused on converting complex, manual workflows into efficient, self-serve solutions.

- 🔭 Currently building **Nuvio**, a B2B SaaS platform — details to follow as it develops
- 📊 Day-to-day job — optimizing campaign performance, user retention, and the data tooling that accelerates decision-making. I also shape our broader business strategy through rigorous competition and pricing analysis, commission modeling, and comprehensive sales forecasting.
- 🤖 Side projects — developed through an **AI-accelerated workflow**, utilizing tools like Claude, Lovable, Antigravity, OpenCode, and OpenRouter for technical execution. Rather than focusing on manual coding across multiple tech stacks, I operate as the product architect. My core expertise lies in Analytics and CRM—identifying strategic business problems and defining the "what" and "why"—while leveraging AI to efficiently handle the "how."
- 📫 Reach me at — **nazmealnahian@gmail.com** or on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nazme-al-nahian/)

---

### ✈️ Air Price Comparison Engine
*Personal automation project*

Compares real-time flight prices across three OTA platforms — **ShareTrip**, **GoZayaan** and
**Shohoz** — for the same itinerary, standard fare vs. discounted fare, side by side.

- Drives two headless-Chromium scrapers plus one direct API integration in parallel, matches
  identical flights across all three platforms, and streams live per-platform progress over
  WebSocket — a full comparison completes in 20–30 seconds
- Handles each platform's convenience-fee structure correctly (they're calculated differently,
  and the code deliberately keeps that distinction rather than "simplifying" it away)
- **Unattended daily price tracking:** a scheduled script prices a configurable route list every
  night at a fixed lead time, merges results into CSV/Excel snapshots, and emails a report —
  failures are surfaced loudly instead of silently logged as empty data
- **Stack:** Node.js, Express, WebSockets, Playwright

---

### 🎟️ Coupon Dashboard
*Internal analytics tool*

A LAN-shared dashboard for tracking coupon-code usage, built to replace a recurring manual SQL
pull with a self-serve tool the wider team can use.

- **Pull Data** page lets anyone extract coupon usage for a code pattern and date range directly
  from the source database — queried one day at a time in the background with live progress,
  merged into per-coupon Excel files without duplicating existing rows
- Dashboard reads those Excel files directly — no database, no login, just point the browser at
  the host machine's LAN address
- Deliberately scoped for a trusted internal network: read-only DB credentials, PII (customer
  phone numbers) kept out of version control, security trade-offs documented rather than assumed
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, React (Vite), MySQL
